detail.longDescription: All you do is upload your resume, and give the site your preferences on location, job titles, pay range, etc, and for free the site finds you a batch of jobs (usually around 5-15 per batch). It takes 10-30 seconds to generate a batch of jobs. The site is free and will always be free for people looking for jobs. It uses agents to check job boards all across the internet to find new / relevant jobs for people. I don't plan to ever make the site cost money for job seekers. For employers, I plan to charge a monthly fee for every live job they want delivered to job seekers. I think this experience is significantly better than using LinkedIn, Indeed, or other websites, even HN. But I believe most people will use multiple job search tools not just one.
